title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Third edition, Volume 14, PAS-PLA - EB.6
text: The purified wells is frequently enjoyed in medicine, in condition with which areatives, particularly for the formation of feline neutral dragts and mixtures. But it is used alab by itself in dolice from three or four points to 15 or as and a frequent epe-rates as a powerful diuretic, particularly when aided by proper dilution. See _TEXAS\_90 and Por-a31._
